build_UnitYModel: build a UnitYModel instance with speech and text encoders, text decoder, and optional T2U model for multimodal translation
build_UnitYX2TModel: build a UnitYX2TModel instance with encoder, decoder, and projection for generic encoder-decoder tasks
build_UnitYT2UModel: build a UnitYT2UModel instance with optional encoder and decoder for text-to-unit generation
build_UnitYNART2UModel: build a non-autoregressive UnitYNART2UModel with NAR decoder frontend and prosody projection for fast text-to-unit synthesis
create_UnitYOutput: create a UnitYOutput dataclass instance holding s2t_output, mt_output, and t2u_output SequenceModelOutput results
